scope: Outcome-blind Sentinel-2 L1C target/reference pairing and windowed crop acquisition for the independent Evanston, Wyoming controlled-release site.

sentinel_2_l1c_stress_acquisition_contra.eligible_targets: all nine frozen, exact-date/platform, officially validated Evanston Sentinel-2 L1C targets; no outcome-based filtering

deterministic_order: lexicographically smallest Sentinel-2 L1C item ID

additional_campaign_exclusions.rule: reject every same-tile Sentinel-2 L1C candidate acquired on a frozen Evanston event UTC date, independent of release rate and including alternate overlapping MGRS products

deterministic_order: lexicographically smallest Sentinel-2 L1C item ID
reference.excluded_scene_ids: all nine selected target scene IDs; campaign-date exclusion also rejects alternate overlapping products

crop.ten_meter_resampling: native target-grid window / nearest for reference alignment
crop.radiometry: raw uint16 Level-1C DNs; no Level-2, SCL, processing-offset, or scale correction
crop.observability: radiometric all-band nonzero fraction only; no cloud channel acquired
crop.access: range/window reads only; never bulk-download full products

sentinel_2_l1c_stress_acquisition_contra.outcome_blindness: Pair selection and raster acquisition omit and do not use Evanston release labels/rates, team detections, or detector outcomes.

forbidden: Do not open Evanston release-data or summary CSVs before a complete immutable label-free score bundle exists.
Do not change the nine target events based on cloud, release magnitude, or later detector behavior.
Do not substitute Sentinel-2 L2A or Landsat L2.
Do not use a same-day, future, or Evanston campaign-date reference.
claim_boundary: A nine-date second-site replication can test geographic transfer at fixed operating points, but its small sample size and public release schedule require exact-binomial uncertainty and no threshold tuning.
